name: food-waste-monorepo
description: AI-Powered Smart Food Waste Prediction and Fair Redistribution (FYP monorepo)

scripts.lint: docker compose exec backend ruff check .
scripts.format: docker compose exec backend ruff format .
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.makemigration: docker compose exec backend alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.seed: docker compose exec backend python -m scripts.seed
scripts.psql: docker compose exec db psql -U foodwaste -d foodwaste
